parameters.name: ServiceResourceType
parameters.description:
The EPS resource type supported by PrivateLink. The available regions vary based on the EPS resource type. You can specify the EPS resource type when querying the regions where PrivateLink is available. Valid values:

- **slb** (default): the EPS resource type is Classic Load Balancer (CLB).
- **alb**: the EPS resource type is Application Load Balancer (ALB).
- **nlb**: the EPS resource type is Network Load Balancer (NLB).
- **gwlb**: the EPS resource type is Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB).

- **ALL**: all of the above.
